checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery/crematory/third parties.
No second mandatory facilities, staff, handling or overhead fee appears; only the basic services fee is described as added.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation offers an option with container provided by purchaser plus fiberboard and wood box options, with no statement a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists what is included and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have itemized prices, and no package, description or policy mentions an unpriced offered item.
The list contains only required single-price items and individual goods/services, with no optional combination package sold at one price.
No text asserts a specific purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory; the only related language is the standard selection and embalming statements.
No text claims long-term delay of decomposition or protection from gravesite substances.
No additional wording undercuts a required disclosure, and differing wording alone is not a concern for this check.
